notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-only for nearly all data - requests with a browser UA fetched each category page's raw HTML (Mango server-renders a React/Next.js payload that embeds a 'catalogId' string even though the visible product grid itself hydrates client-side), then Mango's own public paginated catalog API (api.shop.mango.com/cs/product-lists-drive-thru/v2/channels/shop/countries/us/catalogs/<catalogId>) was queried to totalPages and all productIds deduped for an exact unique-product count. Tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium) was used only for 6 basket/bathroom facet sub-pages (baskets/storage, baskets/decorative, baskets/with-lid, bathroom-baskets/laundry-basket, bathroom-baskets/storage, bathroom-accessories/bathroom-boxes-and-jars) because those facets are applied client-side over the SAME parent catalogId (the API cannot distinguish them) - for those, product cards were counted via full-scroll-to-stability of the DOM, deduped by product id parsed from each card's link href. No block was encountered at any tier; robots.txt (checked first) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow and does not restrict these paths. TREE: Mango Home's nav is a flat list of ~56 category links, confirmed live via https://shop.mango.com/us/en/h/home (the /c/home/ bare landing path itself 404s - only leaf category URLs work) and cross-checked against the stale scratch files left from a prior attempt. Grouping rows below use the site's OWN internal department prefixes visible in each page's catalogId (dormitorio_home=Bedroom, salon_home=Living Room, cocina_home=Table/Kitchen, bano_home=Bathroom, exterior_home=Outdoor/Terrace, ropa_casa_home=apparel/loungewear-excluded) rather than an invented grouping. Material/pattern filter pills inside an already-valid parent listing (e.g. Cushion Covers > Printed/Plain/Striped/Textured; Duvet Covers > Percale/Linen/Satin/Gauze/Washed/Striped) were NOT decomposed into rows since the parent page itself is a complete listing with matching h1 - decomposition was done only for the Baskets and Bathroom Accessories facets because those specific facets split genuine Storage content from Decorative/non-storage content within one parent page. QTY: distinct-productId counts (color variants of the same design deduped to 1), either via the catalogs API (paginated to its own totalPages) or via full DOM scroll-to-stability count on the 6 facet pages noted above - both match what a user scrolling the page would perceive as distinct product cards; no number was estimated, rounded, or aggregated across pages. EXCLUDED and why: apparel/loungewear - pajamas, nightgowns-and-robes, silk (silk pajamas/nightgowns), knitwear (verified = knit pants, not linen), slippers-and-socks, homewear (=home clothes), accessories (=cashmere sleep masks/toiletry bags) - all under the ropa_casa_home apparel department, per textile.md rule 19. Purely decorative, non-textile/non-storage - frames-and-paintings, vases, mirrors, lamps, candles-and-chandeliers, living-room-accessories, flowerpots, decorative-items, bedroom-decoration, boxes-and-jewelry-boxes (h1 explicitly 'DECORATIVE boxes and jewelry boxes'), baskets/decorative facet (verified samples = plain decorative baskets, no storage function), trays (Kitchen&Dining/decor per storage.md example), table-accessories (bread basket/spoon rest, all decorative kitchenware), kitchen-accessories (2 of 3 items decorative bread baskets, the 1 genuine textile kitchen-cloth item is not separable and is already covered by the dedicated Kitchen Linens category), bathroom-accessories parent (soap dispensers/glasses/dishes/trays/vanity mirrors - only its 'bathroom-boxes-and-jars' child qualified as Storage). Promotional/featured collections, identified independently by the site's own 'dest_' catalog-id prefix - decoration, christmas-collection, set-the-table, plus summer-sale-70-off/best-sellers/new-now/our-selection (generic landing/promo pages, no catalogId of their own) - excluded per the View-All/Collection rule in both rule files. Low/medium-confidence inclusions (flagged per-row): Table Items (single pot-holder product under a generically named page), Bathrobes (page mixes 6 bathrobes with 1 toiletry bag/1 turban/1 headband, no bathrobe-only filter exists on-site), Baskets With Lid and Bathroom Storage Boxes and Jars (storage-purpose baskets/jars in a spot the site could also treat as decorative, but explicit product names and h1 text lean storage).
